create_unflattened_module: create an UnflattenedModule from an ExportedProgram to restore the original module hierarchy with submodules
build_interpreter_module: build an InterpreterModule that uses torch.fx.Interpreter for execution instead of GraphModule codegen
summarize_unflatten: sumflatten an ExportedProgram into an UnflattenedModule with the same module hierarchy as the original eager module
